reviews.reason: Questions, visual objects, and teaching-seat tests retain the visual field of whatever meets the eye; the interview load is a deployment rather than another referent.
A staff, hand, or other implement may perform the action, and it may close an address or answer a question, but every witness is the same public strike on the teaching-hall seat or bench.
Unlike replies by maxim, counter-question, shout, whisk, image, or bodily action do not change the lexical identity of the same stock demand for the central meaning of the buddhas’ teaching.
An individual, an assembly, a monk, or a master may be left at a loss after different triggers; participant and trigger variation do not turn the recorded failure to respond into another thing.
Speech, shout, action, and institutional appraisal all concern responding as the presented occasion calls; the kind of response changes, not the situational relation.
Display, exhaustion, matching, and criticism are predicates applied to the same responsive operation shown in encounters; appraisal and degree do not establish another referent.
Individual and collective biographies report realization after words, questions, cases, or accidents; trigger, number of people, and aftermath vary while the realization event remains the same.
A person’s own native ground or native-ground scenery and an administrative adjective meaning local name different things and each has its own exact occurrence; this is not merely alternate phrasing.
Pivot, function, saying, gesture, and negation all concern subtle workings in the lexical witnesses; the personal name Xuanji is a homonym assigned to the master roster, not a lexical sense.

Receiving students, lower faculties, beings, or the dead changes actor and object but retains the action of receiving and leading onward; Reception Pavilion is a compound modifier-control, not an independent sense of the standalone verb.
